reason: An interactive DSH Web canvas for visualizing agent, subagent, workflow, phase, and tool-call relationships from live session data, with adjustable force-directed layout and theme support.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 中将 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 和工具调用实时展示为可交互的关系画布。
summaries.en: An interactive DSH Web canvas that visualizes agents, subagents, workflows, phases, and tool calls from live session data.

capabilities: Displays session snapshots and session lists
Visualizes agents, subagents, workflows, phases, tool calls, and tool results
Provides interactive graph pan, zoom, node dragging, and layout adjustment
Adapts to light and dark themes
